title: feat(approvals): platform_admin approver type for a deployment's own packaged flows
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCpddLFmKzR39wJWZpkRMCi)_

Fixes #34218

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

The widening: `ApproverType` accepts a new member, `platform_admin`, which takes no `value`. Nothing accepted before is refused. The narrowing that comes with it applies only to the new member: it is refused outside the running body of a `source: 'code'` package's flow.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:审批节点新增审批人类型 `platform_admin`,把一步交给平台管理员处理;"只有该类型能打开平台管理员槽位"这条规则在决策、越权、收件箱各入口实际读取的待审名单上成立;本轮起,请求在开启时记下"由 `platform_admin` 步骤打开了该槽位",各入口只在带此记录的请求上认这个槽位。
- 为什么改:平台自带的流程(cloud#4632 在等)需要平台管理员审批;合同审核 6912724496 与复审 6916583417 要求该规则在各入口读取的名单上、对每一个请求都成立。
- 风险与回滚:只有部署在代码里注册的包的流程能用它,别处一律拒绝开启;含该槽位的请求,组织管理员不能越权代审;不带开启记录的请求上,各入口不认该槽位,存量数据不改写、无需迁移;回滚即撤这个 PR。
- 先看:`approval-service.ts` 的 `pendingSlateOf` 与 `syncApproverIndex`(开启记录与各入口的读法),`approver-address.ts` 的 `pendingSlateAsDoorsRead` 与 `readsAsPlatformAdminAddress`,再看 `stepRunsInArmedBody`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run src/platform-admin-approver-34218.test.ts`,预期 52 条全过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **spec** (`packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts`): `ApproverType` gains `platform_admin`. Its value binding is `auto` (no `value`), it is not org-scoped, and it is in `NON_AUTHORABLE_APPROVER_TYPES`, so no designer offers it. The `.describe()` text says who may use it. The generated reference (`content/docs/references/automation/approval.mdx`) is regenerated.
- **expansion** (`approval-service.ts`, `approver-address.ts`): the type expands to ONE address slot, `platform_admin:*`. No administrator is enumerated, no one is notified, and the slot grants no record read. `slateNamesAPerson` counts it, so `onEmptyApprovers` does not treat the slate as empty.
- **admission**: `actingAddresses` adds the slot for a caller whose `platformAdmin` flag is set, and `resolveActor` admits a caller naming the slot. Both read `hasPlatformAdminStanding(engine, callerId)` from `@objectstack/core` at that moment, memoized per request context. The predicate is not re-derived, it has no org scope, and it never reads the session's posture. A decision records the person (`actor_id`) and the slot (`acted_as`), in the #21411 shape.
- **only the typed approver opens the slot, on the slate the doors read** (`approver-address.ts`, `approval-service.ts`): `readStoredSlate` is the one reading of a stored slate. `readsAsPlatformAdminAddress` and `withoutPlatformAdminAddress` judge the slot on what that reading answers, for any entry, text or not: an entry that is not text is judged as the text the stored slate holds for it. The rule is applied wherever a slate is resolved or rewritten: each approver entry in `expandApprovers` (the approvers, the fallback slate, the administrators' slate, and the tally's legacy re-resolution), an out-of-office hop in `applyOooDelegation` (the slot stays with its approver), the SLA hand-over's holders, and `reassignTargetRefusal` (reassign, and the SLA's literal target), which now judges the slot first. An entry that resolves to the slot adds nothing and logs one warning naming the entry. A vote's rewrite of the slate is a subset of the open-time snapshot, which these rules built.
- **the doors honour the slot only on a request a `platform_admin` step opened** (`approval-service.ts`, `approver-address.ts`): when a request opens, its config snapshot records `__platformAdminSlotOpened: true` exactly when the step names the `platform_admin` type (admitted at node entry) and the slate holds the slot. Only the open path writes it, and a key of that name handed in with a step's config is dropped (`ApprovalNodeConfigSchema` declares none). Every door reads the pending slate through one reader, `pendingSlateOf` (`pendingSlateAsDoorsRead`), which keeps the slot only on a request that carries the record: the served request and its per-viewer flags, the decision, send-back, comment, hand-off, reminder and override admissions, the action-link minting, the SLA hand-over, and the approver index behind the inbox (`syncApproverIndex` on every write that sets the slate, and the rebuild at plugin start). The stored text is not rewritten.
- **who may name it**: at node entry, `platformAdminApproverRefusal` reads the armed body's package through `flowPackageOf` (`armedFlowPackage`), never `packagedFlowOwner`. A registry row with `source: 'code'` is admitted. A row with any other source is refused. With no row, the residual-owner reading applies: `residualOwnerSource` `'code'` admits, and anything else refuses. The fallback slate is checked the same way. The origin is answered for the body whose step is being opened: the approval executor hands the node it runs (`approval-node.ts`), and `stepRunsInArmedBody` opens the step only when the body armed under the flow's key (the run's slot through `getFlowSlot`, else the bare name through `getFlow`) holds that node object. A refusal throws `FORBIDDEN: …` before anything is written.
- **override**: on a request whose pending slate holds `platform_admin:*`, the #3424 tenant-admin (organization administrator) override arm is withheld at every override admission: decide, reassign, recall, and the `viewer.can_override` flag they agree with. `isOverrideActor` takes the slate from those admissions only (the read grants pass none), and the slot test is `slateHoldsPlatformAdminAddress`. The platform-admin override arm and the system context are unchanged. Override is whole-request, so on a mixed slate the guard holds for the whole request, and the ordinary slot holder still decides as a slot holder.
- **moving the slot**: reassigning the platform slot itself needs platform standing now, the platform override, or the system.
- **save door** (`packages/lint`): `validateApprovalApprovers` takes `{ atSaveDoor }`. The runtime publish gate passes it (`ctx.runtimeWriteType !== undefined`), and there a `platform_admin` approver, or fallback approver, is an error, `approval-approver-platform-admin-authored`. `os lint` and the other CLI commands know the type and refuse nothing. The rule id is exported from the barrel.
- **docs**: `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` gains a "Routing to the platform administrators" section.

## Tests

`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/platform-admin-approver-34218.test.ts`, 52 tests: real ObjectQL over SQLite, the real `hasPlatformAdminStanding`, a real package registry with code, marketplace and authored packages and recorded residual owners, and (for the origin pins) the real `AutomationEngine`.

- The slot opens and tells no one. A grant admin and the verified configured owner (no grant row) each find it in the inbox and decide it as an ordinary approver (`actor_id` the person, `acted_as` the slot, not an override).
- A member of the request's organization takes no slot. An organization administrator takes no slot and no override (decide, reassign, recall refused; `viewer` `{ can_act: false, can_override: false }`); another organization's administrator cannot decide. Mixed slate: the organization administrator is withheld whole, the ordinary holder decides. CONTROLS: the tenant arm is unchanged on a slate without the slot; the platform override arm is unchanged on it.
- A revoked administrator cannot decide a request opened before the revocation.
- Refused at node entry, writing nothing: a flow authored in the environment, an environment override of a host flow, a marketplace package's flow, an authored package's, an unrecorded package's, a marketplace residual's, and a fallback slate naming the type. A residual owner a code door recorded is admitted.
- **Cases 1 to 23: no route but the typed approver opens the slot on the slate the doors read.** Each case resolves or rewrites a slate on one route (approver entries of each kind, record values, directory values, an out-of-office delegation, a fallback slate, the administrators' slate, a vote, the SLA hand-over, a hand-off target, a queue's members, an expression yielding a list of people) and asserts, for cases 7 to 23, every door: the request as served, the inbox after the approver index is rebuilt from the stored slate, the decision admission for a caller in platform standing naming the slot, and the override admission (the tenant arm stands).
- The slot test is total: each entry that is not text is judged as the text the stored slate holds for it.
- **The doors honour the slot only on a request that records a `platform_admin` step opened it.** CONTROL: a request a `platform_admin` step opened records it, and every door reads the slot (served, listed for a platform administrator, the tenant arm withheld, decided under the slot). A request whose snapshot carries no record, its stored slate unchanged: no door reads the slot (served without it, not listed, decision under it refused, the tenant arm stands), and its people decide as before. On such a request, a vote that rewrites the slate indexes no slot for the inbox. A step's config cannot carry the record: the spec schema refuses the key, and the open path drops it.
- The platform's place on a mixed slate moves only for a platform administrator or the system.
- **The origin is answered for the body whose step is being opened, on the real flow engine:** a real run of a code package's flow opens on the slot, the origin read through the run's slot (`getFlowSlot`); on that read and on the bare read (`getFlow`), the armed body's own step opens and a step the armed body does not hold is refused, writing nothing. The stand-in pins for the same rule stay.
- The save door refuses the type; `os lint` refuses nothing. CONTROL: a `user` approver opens as before and the platform administrator takes no slot on it.

Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the pin file, source-imported so no dist leg; every leg restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty, and no marker left):

- On head 5c867107, in one lock hold after the typecheck:
  - (S3 doors) `pendingSlateAsDoorsRead` keeping the slot without the record: `Tests 2 failed | 50 passed (52)`, the two requests without the record, e.g. `AssertionError: expected { Object (served, listed, ...) } to deeply equal { served: [ 'u_alice' ], …(2) }`. The CONTROL stays green.
  - (S3 index) `syncApproverIndex` indexing the slot without the record: `Tests 1 failed | 51 passed (52)`, the vote on a request without the record, `AssertionError: expected [ …(6) ] to not include 'areq_…'`.
  - (S3 record) the open path keeping a record handed in with the config: `Tests 1 failed | 51 passed (52)`, `AssertionError: expected { approvers: [ { …(2) } ], …(2) } to not have property "__platformAdminSlotOpened"`.
  - (N7) the slot test without the text coercion: `Tests 1 failed | 51 passed (52)`, the totality pin.
  - (S2) `stepRunsInArmedBody` answering yes without asking the armed body: `Tests 4 failed | 48 passed (52)`, the real-engine slot read and bare read and the two stand-in pins, e.g. `AssertionError: promise resolved "{ …(25) }" instead of rejecting`.
- On head 275b45c8: (M1) `readsAsPlatformAdminAddress` reverted to the earlier judgement of the slot: `Tests 15 failed | 30 passed (45)`, exactly cases 7 to 21, e.g. case 21 `AssertionError: promise resolved "{ request: { …(31) } }" instead of rejecting`.

Earlier rounds' ablations (standing check, decision-only standing check, source gate, tenant-arm guard, save door both ways) are recorded in the dev report on the card at 21dd2417 and in the hand-off; their anchors are unchanged on this head.

## Fix rounds

- Round 1 (`8cb89ac5` to `084419d6`): the type, its one slot, admission by live platform standing, the origin gate at node entry, the save door, pins and docs.
- Round 2 (`5282972a`, `cffa4a47`, seat ruling Q1 = B): the tenant-admin override is withheld from a request whose slate holds the platform slot, a mixed slate whole.
- Round 3 (`0a0baffc` to `ba113a3f`, ruling 6904694980 point 2 as amended by 6904772436, hand-off 6912407414): only the typed approver opens the slot on the resolved slate, and the origin is answered for the body whose step is being opened.
- Round 4 (`275b45c8`, contract review 6912724496): the rule holds on the slate the decision, override and inbox doors read, for every way a slate is resolved or rewritten; the origin rule is pinned on the real flow engine, on both reads.
- Round 5 (`f1a021ef`, `5c867107`, contract review delta 6916583417): the doors honour the slot only on a request that records a `platform_admin` step opened it; the slot test is total for entries that are not text; pins for a queue and an expression yielding a list of people.

## Acceptance notes

- **The slot stands in for the card's "pending approvers" wording.** The request stores one address, `platform_admin:*`, as its pending approver, the way `position:NAME` is stored. The administrators are never listed onto it.
- **Spelling `platform_admin:*`, not bare `platform_admin`.** The readers tell an address from a person by the colon, so a bare word would read as a user id. The `*` says it names no one.
- **Organization administrators (seat ruling Q1 = B).** They take no slot, and the #3424 tenant-admin override is withheld from any request whose slate holds `platform_admin:*`, a mixed slate whole. The platform-admin override arm is unchanged. The type is new, so no served answer moves.
- **Requests without the record.** The doors honour the platform slot only on a request that records a `platform_admin` step opened it. A pending request without that record keeps its stored text as it is, so nothing is migrated: no door reads the slot on it, and its other approvers, and the override arms as on `main`, decide it.
- **Inputs accepted on `main` whose behaviour moves (rule-level):** an approver entry, out-of-office delegate, SLA target or hand-off target that resolves to the platform slot now adds nothing to the slate (a hand-off or SLA target is refused, and the slate stays). On `main` such an entry left a literal on the slate that no acting path admitted, so no request could be decided through it.
- **Inbox reads**: one extra `resolveUserAuthzGrants` read per caller per request context, memoized. The server inbox listing still applies the caller's active-organization wall (nit N3, for the cloud lane to confirm before cloud#4632 relies on it).
- A `value` on `platform_admin` is ignored, not refused.
- **Follow-ups, not built here:** nit N3 (above) is #34409; nit N6 (a deployment where nobody has platform standing opens the step on a slot nobody can take, and nothing warns) and the slot's raw display label (nit N4) are #34410.
- **Files beyond the claim's literal list, ratified within the surface:** `approver-address.ts`, `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`, `packages/lint/src/index.ts` (seat ruling Q2 = A), and `approval-node.ts` (hand-off 6912407414).
- **cloud#4632 consumes this.** The cloud lane was asked to confirm that its packaging registers as `source: 'code'`. A marketplace or authored registration is refused at node entry by design.
